powers.name: Blow

powers.text: It sounds a blast only one chosen creature within 600 ft can hear. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: 4 charges: a blast only one creature you choose can hear.
text: The horn holds 4 charges, and blowing it (a Magic action) uses one. Its blare reaches just one creature you pick, as long as that creature is within 600 feet and isn't Deafened; to everyone else the horn makes no sound at all. Each dawn it recovers 1d4 spent charges.
